title: Revocation Status
situation: A new decision is compared against an older record whose approval was later revoked. The current decision history contains a replacement, but it is unclear whether the replacement is still valid.

note: 같은 topic_key 결정과 먼저 비교 (절차 확인)
title: Detailed-Topic Match
situation: The team has multiple valid decisions on separate detailed topics, and a new decision arrives. The same detailed topic has one earlier decision, while other related decisions use different topic_key values.

title: Ambiguous Decision
situation: A new decision is recorded as approved, but its content is only “Use the smaller one.” Earlier messages mention both a smaller logo and a smaller sample size, and the approving message has no quoted context.

title: Team Identity Mix-up
situation: Two different class teams have the same name, “North Star,” but one is researching youth housing and the other is building a campus navigation app. A decision from one team is accidentally uploaded to the other team’s feed.

title: Mixed Chat Audit
situation: A staff member requests an audit of a batch containing confirmed decisions, proposals, jokes, research facts, personal messages, and sensitive details mixed into team-chat sentences.

title: Missing Decision Metadata
situation: The agent receives an approved decision with normalized content and an owner but no original sentence, topic key, or approval date. Existing decisions include several similar but distinct deliverables.
